note: Shared reference material every install ships with. The portal reads this file on install and when updating (src/features/references). Every source works offline from the copy in this repository; a source with `vendored` set is served from that path, and GitHub is only asked (with a short timeout) when checking for a newer version. If GitHub is unreachable nothing changes.

sources.name: Shine CSS
sources.usedFor: Styling of the portal (admin) and the public site. Replaces Tailwind. Admin-only extras live in src/styles/engage-utilities.css (generated by scripts/generate-utilities.mjs).

sources.name: Effix
sources.usedFor: Effects and charts applied with efx- classes. The loader starts only when a page uses an efx- class and fails safe when the CDN is unreachable.

sources.name: Engage templates
sources.usedFor: Default template library, listed in Templates next to the built-in starters. Can be switched off in Settings > Template libraries.
